source: Authenticated Search Console UI in the owner-selected account

index_inspection.note: Index snapshot before the post-release live test; null means unavailable, not a canonical conflict.

indexing_request.purpose: Reinspect the changed production page after the verified release
indexing_request.note: Google says duplicate requests do not change queue position; no further repeat requests made.

sitemap.note: 45 is the previous processed discovery count, not an indexed total or the current live sitemap size.

limits: A live URL test establishes availability, not completed indexing or ranking.
One URL inspection is not a complete-site index report.
No ranking improvement can be inferred minutes after deployment.
